_comment: Facilitator reference for the Lab 04 checkpoint: what a good result looks like. Participants submit nothing; they compare with the Expected output block on the lab page. validation_type and notes describe how to judge a reply if you review one.

checkpoints.notes: Manual discussion, not an evaluation run. One agent is enough when one instruction/tool set handles the task. Sequential fixes stages in code; handoff selects among developer-permitted routes. A graph alone proves neither execution nor a tool call; ask participants to identify the recorded handoff call and final answerer.

Shared-browser comparison; nothing to submit. Sequential: Nutrition -> Activity -> Coach, ending in cited evidence JSON. Handoff: Coach -> Nutrition -> Activity, ending with Activity's answer; Nutrition's output is earlier. Hosted sequential proof adds resident_profile and still requires cited JSON. Do not require merged JSON from the handoff team.

Sequential still visits Nutrition, Activity and Coach. Intended handoff route is Coach -> Activity with only handoff_to_activity. Discuss deviations. No speed threshold: the handoff example also omits the final merge, so output work differs.

Optional facilitator-only extension, not a core checkpoint. Skip when Fabric is paused. Programme-Insights is separate from the DevUI teams. Answer grouped by programme; top programme matches reference-answers.json#q_programmes_disengaged_enrolled (+-1 rank); no resident_id.
